title: Book Three · Chapter 188: The Offer in Spring
story:
In March, Ronan completes his eleventh working week.

Four more Friday payments have added another one hundred and twenty yuan. His work envelope holds three hundred and ninety-nine.

Dad and Mum make their March payment of twelve and eight. Their study envelope reaches two hundred and sixty. With the old twenty and a half, all three amounts total six hundred and seventy-nine and a half.

Spring has come when the coastal letter arrives.

Ronan sees the address and carries the envelope to the table. Mum puts her sewing down while he opens it.

The first line has his name. The next says: We offer you a place in the summer programme.

He stops. Then he reads it again.

“A place?” Mum asks.

“Yes.”

His voice is quieter than he expected. He gives her the page, then takes it back to read the whole letter.

The programme has two teaching terms of four months. The class fee stays one hundred and eighty for each term. The shared room stays sixty for each teaching term too.

The basic class materials are included. He must bring bedding and personal things. A route sheet shows the current local bus from the arrival station. Its fare is one yuan.

He puts a mark beside the route.

The centre asks for his signed answer by the first Friday in May. Class and room payments will be due when he arrives before lessons begin. No money is required with his answer.

Ronan lays the letter flat.

“I need to read the dates with Dad too,” he says.

Mum nods. Then she puts one hand on his shoulder.

“They read your work.”

He looks at the line with his name and smiles at last.

When Dad comes home, Ronan meets him in the yard with the letter.

Dad reads the offer slowly. He gives the page back, then takes Ronan's shoulder in one hand.

“You wanted a real chance.”

“I do.”

They stand together for a moment before Mum calls them to dinner.

Later, Ronan shows Anna the offer beside the library steps. She reads the first line and looks up with a bright smile.

He takes both her hands.

“I am still waiting for mine,” she says.

“I hope it comes soon.”

“I do too.”

She squeezes his fingers, then reads the class description with him. He turns the page so they can both see it clearly in the spring light.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

offer＝正式提供一个机会；required＝要求的、必须的；included＝包括在费用中；signed answer＝签名确认的答复。

## 理解问题

1. 这次来信和此前收件信有什么不同？确认答复与实际付课费分别在何时？
2. 三月实际钱合计多少？剩下四周工资已经提前算进去了吗？

## 读句子

**Ronan lays the letter flat.**

拆开看：Ronan / lays the letter / flat.

Ronan／把录取来信放下／平铺在桌上。
